ios-forms|Image wells.summary: A Plenix image upload on iOS opens the system photo picker (PhotosPicker, PHPickerViewController) or the document picker from a Plenix control and shows the chosen picture in a frame of a fixed ratio with the media radius, the neutral fill while it loads, and Replace and Remove beside it; a profile picture is the Plenix avatar (a rounded square, never a circle) with Change photo and Remove photo. Cropping uses the system’s own editing where it exists. Apple’s image well is a Mac control people drop images on; on iOS the picker is the way in, and Plenix keeps it.

variants.name: Single (default)
variants.swiftui: PhotosPicker(selection: $item, matching: .images) with a Plenix secondary button, then the picture in a framed preview
variants.appkit: NSImageView with isEditable = true (an image well) and NSOpenPanel
variants.use: One picture: a cover or a header image.

variants.name: Multiple
variants.swiftui: PhotosPicker(selection: $items, maxSelectionCount: max) and a LazyVGrid of square previews

variants.name: Avatar
variants.swiftui: the Plenix avatar (RoundedRectangle with Plenix.Radius.radiusAvatar8px) beside Change photo and Remove photo
variants.uikit: a UIImageView with layer.cornerRadius = Plenix.Radius.radiusAvatar8px and a PHPicker
variants.appkit: NSImageView with the avatar corner (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

anatomy.name: Choose control
anatomy.about: A Plenix secondary button that opens the system picker.

anatomy.name: Preview
anatomy.about: The chosen picture in a frame of the ratio, with the media radius and the thin border.

anatomy.name: File name
anatomy.about: The name and size in DM Mono, the data role.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.about: Replace and Remove, or Change photo and Remove photo.

states.uikit: the picked image in the view

swiftui: /// The Plenix image upload on iOS: the system photo picker, the picture in a framed 16:9 preview.
.aspectRatio(16 / 9, contentMode: .fit) // the aspect-ratio scale (16:9), not a system value
.task(id: item) { if let data = try? await item?.loadTransferable(type: Data.self), let ui = UIImage(data: data) { image = Image(uiImage: ui) } }
appkit: // AppKit: PlenixTokens.swift is iOS-only (UIColor); a macOS build of the tokens is needed for these names.
well.isEditable = true // an image well people drop pictures on
